groups.proposed_action: Review 48V half-bridge QH/QL, Cr, C5, R18 and U2 switch-node geometry. Draw SHORT, current-qualified local F.Cu shapes and dedicated low-current SW sense pickup; preserve limited SW copper area and creepage.
must_validate: Native QH/Q L copper and actual OEM drain/source pin mapping
Hot-loop geometry and commutation inductance / gate return
Actual 48V input/ripple current, copper thickness, copper temperature
KiCad native DRC after zone refill and full current-path continuity
groups.do_not: Do not join 7 SW ratsnest items with 0.2mm signal traces.

groups.proposed_action: Review J_IN.1 to QH high-side input pins and Cin.1 bypass loop. Use a current-qualified short copper polygon/plane with verified input connector pad geometry and input return.
groups.do_not: Do not declare VIN_P complete based on a thin scenic trace.

groups.proposed_action: Jointly optimize local U2, R4, R18, C5, D_BT, QH placements. Keep GH_DRV and HB bootstrap loops compact and pair their SW return; evaluate a physical relayout before routing across other nets.
must_validate: Real U2 OEM 0.5mm pitch pad/courtyard before moving
Gate-loop inductance and turn-off loop overshoot
Bootstrap charging/return current and nearest physical switch-node pickup
No fine-pitch via-in-pad, no uncontrolled through-layer gate path
groups.do_not: Do not consume a B.Cu multi-via detour to make DRC green without parasitic verification.

groups.proposed_action: Source and pickup are approximately 58mm apart. Re-evaluate physical OC comparator/control placement, controlled return and shielding, noise immunity and propagation delay rather than auto-connecting a long unguarded switching-adjacent signal.
must_validate: Protection latency and open-circuit fault behavior
groups.do_not: Do not substitute a long unverified digital/analog OC trace for a local fault chain.

additional_hard_gates: T1-T4/CT 3:1:1 real PCB windings and OEM DOTs, not placeholder rectangles
100A paired copper busbar, output multi-contact terminal and parasitic thermal verification
Schematic-to-native-pad parity (empty reported parity != authenticated parity)
Actual 12-layer stackup and via-in-pad filled/capped vendor process
Maxwell extraction/mesh independence, SR recovery/current sharing and real EMI/thermal validation
